title: Create enhanced SkillManager with cache, validation, and prefetch
description: New file agent-support/skills.ts. Enhanced SkillManager with: (1) in-memory cache Map with 5-minute TTL — avoids D1 on every inference call; (2) getSkillInstructions(names) — fetches only cache misses from D1, warns on unknown names; (3) prefetch(names) — populates cache without returning content, called from onStart(); (4) validate(names) — returns { valid, missing } sets for agentInit() startup check; (5) resolveEffective(staticSkills, dynamicSkills) — union and deduplication of static + request-time skills; (6) private wrap(contents) — formats as <skill_context>...</skill_context>. Non-fatal throughout — D1 errors return empty string.
success_criteria: Cache hit on second call within TTL — no D1 round-trip
Unknown skill names trigger console.warn with names listed
prefetch() calls getSkillInstructions internally (fills cache as side effect)
validate() returns { valid: [], missing: ['bad-name'] } for unknown skill
